name: picocalc-mcp

tools.name: picocalc_status
tools.description: Check PicoCalc device connection status, RAM, SD card, and firmware version.

tools.name: picocalc_exec
tools.description: Execute MicroPython code on the PicoCalc device. Returns stdout and stderr. Use for testing, debugging, reading sensors, or running one-off commands. 30 second timeout -- do not use for launching apps with main loops.

code.description: Python code to execute on the device

tools.name: picocalc_push
tools.description: Push a local file to the PicoCalc device. The local_path is relative to the MicroPython/ directory in the project.

local_path.description: Local file path relative to MicroPython/ dir (e.g. sd/py_scripts/my_app.py)

tools.name: picocalc_list_files
tools.description: List files on the PicoCalc device at a given path. Returns file names, types, and sizes.

tools.name: picocalc_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the PicoCalc device and return its contents.

tools.name: picocalc_reset
tools.description: Soft reset the PicoCalc device. Re-runs boot.py and main.py.
